g.text: Same mass and charge, different kinetic energy: extra mirror time offsets the faster ion’s shorter drift time.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616b

g.text: At the design energy, drift and mirror each contribute half the total time. The total has zero first derivative, not zero higher-order spread.
